title: Celigo lookupcache
description: Writable fields for creating or updating a lookup cache.

x-celigo-canon.reason: Do not set additionalProperties false — the server accepts and silently strips unknown top-level fields rather than rejecting them.

Server accepts an empty create body and defaults name to the empty string, so name is neither required nor non-empty — machine-generated ephemeral caches routinely carry empty names. Do not add minLength either.

description.description: Purpose or contents of the cache.
examples: Maps external customer IDs to internal Salesforce IDs for deduplication

includeDataInTemplatesAndCloning.description:
Whether to include the cached key-value data when this cache is
used in templates or cloned. When `false` (default), only
metadata transfers. Set to `true` for static reference tables.

x-celigo-canon.reason: Server defaults the value on omission — universal stored presence is server-written.

x-celigo-ai-guidance:
When false (default), only the cache metadata is included — the actual
key-value data is not transferred. Set to true if the cached data is
part of the integration's configuration (e.g., static reference tables).

x-celigo-canon.reason: Free-form by design — values are caller-chosen and need not look like object ids; a very long probe value was accepted. No pattern, format, or length cap.
